text:
- **Sprint close and drafts:** Sprint close now publishes drafts from every workspace in one commit. It refuses to close on overlap or conflict.
- **Docs rendering and checks:** Docs now typeset TeX math, and links resolve by slug. A docs index lists every doc, and pm check refuses dead record links and JSX in raw HTML.
- **Command surface simplification:** An audit measured the pm command surface and ranked several simplifications. Work started to apply them, including a rewrite of the pm-cli design page.
- **Record layer rollout:** A sprint opened to add per-clone draft refs and move this repo to the new record layer. A live check on this repo after the upgrade is planned.
